column1: # NFTBan — CANONICAL PER-SOURCE CONNLIMIT SERVICE DECLARATIONS

# meta:description="P12-A02 canonical connlimit declarations. DATA, never executable code. Carries the NAME of the policy variable, never its value: conf.d/ddos/classic.conf remains the sole value authority. Consumed by the connlimit renderer, which owns nft syntax only. One row per service class; MAIL owns port 25 (the fragment SMTP/25 rule was a duplicate projection of this row and is removed)."
# ⛔ MUST NOT appear in this file: fallback numeric values · shell commands ·
#    sed expressions · package-specific syntax · runtime set members.
# ⛔ PROJECTED_BY is declarative ownership, not a hint:
#    A service must be projected by EXACTLY ONE of them. MAIL is base-only and
#    already covers port 25; a second SMTP projection is a duplicate, not an extra
#    protection (v1.67.1 applied this same criterion to SSH and HTTP).
# ⛔ SET_V4/SET_V6 are DYNAMIC sets. Their MEMBERS are created by nftables at packet
#    evaluation via `add @set { ip saddr ct count over N }`. They must NEVER be
#    populated by _firewall_set_elements() or the Go set-normalisation code, which
#    own static config-derived sets such as @ssh_ports.
# SERVICE  PORT_EXPR              LIMIT_VAR                      SET_V4              SET_V6              PROJECTED_BY
